concepts.name: NDA effective date
justifications: The agreement states that the Effective Date is 1 February 2027, distinct from the 29 January 2027 signing date.

concepts.name: NDA permitted purpose
predicted: sole permitted purpose: evaluating a possible minority investment by the recipient in the discloser's marine sensor business under project glassfinch
gold: evaluating a possible minority investment by the recipient in the discloser's marine sensor business under project glassfinch.
values: Sole permitted purpose: evaluating a possible minority investment by the Recipient in the Discloser's marine sensor business under Project Glassfinch
justifications: Section 1.2 defines the sole Permitted Purpose as evaluating a minority investment in the marine sensor business under Project Glassfinch. Competing business, product development, other acquisitions and machine-learning training are excluded.

concepts.name: NDA disclosure window end
justifications: The ordinary window end of 31 January 2028 was closed earlier by a valid termination notice delivered 24 November 2027, effective 30 November 2027, and no later instrument changes it.

concepts.name: NDA contractual forum
justifications: The parties designate the courts of Oslo as their contractual forum, with Norwegian law governing the agreement.

concepts.name: NDA signatory entities
justifications: FjordSignal AS is registered in Norway under number 923 456 781 and is designated as the Discloser.
Talus Ventures AB is registered in Sweden under number 559123-4567 and is designated as the Recipient.

concepts.name: Protected assets at the April snapshot
justifications: At the 7 April 2027 snapshot, LUMEN, SHORE, CEDAR and BASALT remain protected as complete assets. ORACLE is in a protection gap, and MICA is wholly excluded by established independent development.

concepts.name: ORACLE timely confirmation deadline
justifications: Counting five Business Days from Thursday 25 March 2027 skips the excluded dates of 26 and 29 March, so the deadline falls on 5 April 2027 at 17:00 UTC.

concepts.name: ORACLE protection timeline
predicted: protection is not continuous. oral disclosure on 25 march 2027 was provisionally protected until the confirmation deadline of 5 april 2027 at 17:00 utc, and that protection ended there because the confirmation was delivered late on 6 april 2027 at 09:05, even though it was sent at 16:58 on 5 april. protection was restored prospectively only from the written acceptance on 8 april 2027 at 10:00, leaving an unprotected gap from 5 april 17:00 to 8 april 10:00; sending time is irrelevant and delivery governs.
gold: oracle is provisionally protected from the 25 march oral disclosure until 5 april 2027 at 17:00 utc. confirmation sent before that deadline arrived late on 6 april at 09:05, so protection lapses after the deadline. it resumes prospectively when the recipient expressly accepts on 8 april at 10:00 utc; the gap is not cured retroactively.
values: Protection is not continuous. Oral disclosure on 25 March 2027 was provisionally protected until the confirmation deadline of 5 April 2027 at 17:00 UTC, and that protection ended there because the confirmation was delivered late on 6 April 2027 at 09:05, even though it was sent at 16:58 on 5 April. Protection was restored prospectively only from the written acceptance on 8 April 2027 at 10:00, leaving an unprotected gap from 5 April 17:00 to 8 April 10:00; sending time is irrelevant and delivery governs.
justifications: The timeline shows a gap because the late-delivered confirmation ended provisional protection at the deadline and acceptance restored it only prospectively. Delivery, not sending, controls the timing under the rules.

concepts.name: Entire SHORE package excluded by prior possession
justifications: The prior-possession evidence covers only the older S-17 module, which is incorporated in S-92, while S-92 also contains a new non-public branching map and thresholds. Component-level exclusion does not exclude the entire package.

concepts.name: CEDAR end of protection
justifications: The Discloser's independent, lawful public release of the entire CEDAR schedule on 15 June 2027 establishes an exclusion that ends protection as soon as it is established. The later identical resend in September did not restart protection.

concepts.name: People permitted LUMEN access at the September snapshot
justifications: Elin is the Recipient's own employee with all approvals effective by 6 September. Marek is an employee of an Affiliate with his approvals effective before the snapshot, and Oskar is an external lawyer whose professional duty of confidence and approvals are in place and who is not a competitor employee.

concepts.name: Talus Research qualifying voting percentage
justifications: The Recipient directly holds 48 percent of general shareholder votes and has a presently effective irrevocable proxy over another 4 percent, with no double counting. The revocable 6 percent proxy and non-voting or board-appointment rights are excluded.

concepts.name: Marek earliest authorised LUMEN access
justifications: Marek is an Affiliate employee whose protective undertaking and security check were complete by 10 September, but his named clean-room approval only becomes effective on 14 September, which is the earliest date he may access LUMEN. Express effective dates control over earlier signature dates.

concepts.name: Executed competitor consent date for Pia
Q-27 notice deadline date
justifications: The notice prohibition was lifted on 5 July 2027 at 11:20, so the six-continuous-hour deadline falls at 17:20 that day, earlier than the 6 July production time. Excluded dates do not affect continuous-hour periods.

concepts.name: Q-27 notice lateness in minutes
justifications: The notice reached the Discloser's mailbox at 17:55 on 5 July 2027, against a 17:20 deadline, and the after-hours deferral does not apply to initially prohibited notices. This gives 35 whole minutes of lateness.

concepts.name: Q-27 permitted production units
justifications: The final binding narrowing order requires all of P1 and only the non-privileged subsection P3A. P3B is privileged, and P2 and P4 were withdrawn entirely.

concepts.name: WORK-1 deletion deadline
justifications: The return request was delivered on 22 November 2027 at 16:00, which is earlier than the termination date. Counting ten Business Days, excluding the 25 and 26 November holidays, ends on 8 December 2027, and restoration does not reset that deadline.

concepts.name: BK-1 deletion deadline
justifications: The backup is kept until the earlier of its scheduled overwrite and 45 calendar days after the trigger, which falls on 6 January 2028. The earlier date is the scheduled overwrite on 30 December 2027, and restoration does not extend it.

concepts.name: Artifacts permitted retention at the December snapshot
justifications: ARCH-1 is the permitted counsel-held archive, BK-1 is the immutable backup still within its overwrite window at the snapshot, and HOLD-1 is covered by a binding preservation order. WORK-1 is an ordinary active copy in breach and NOTE-1 has no exception.

concepts.name: NOTE-1 model training permitted as residual knowledge
justifications: Training on Confidential Information requires a separate signed licence, and residual-knowledge permission excludes recorded notes and quantitative parameters. NOTE-1 consists of recorded parameter values with no licence, consent, or preservation coverage.
